title: Bank Management System
requirements: Support customer accounts (Savings, Current/Checking), deposits, withdrawals, transfers, interest calculation, and transaction history.
oopConcepts: Encapsulation (`balance_` private), Abstraction (`Account`), Runtime Polymorphism (`withdraw`, `applyMonthlyUpdate`), RAII.
responsibilities:
- `Account`: maintains `accountNo_`, `balance_`, transaction log, invariant `balance >= -overdraft`.
  - `BankService`: coordinates atomic transfers between two accounts.
umlDiagram:
Customer ◇--- Account (abstract) ◆--- Transaction
                 ^
        +--------+--------+
        |                 |
 SavingsAccount    CheckingAccount
followUps:
1. *How do you prevent race conditions or deadlocks during `transfer(A, B, amt)`?* (Lock accounts in canonical ID order `std::scoped_lock` in C++17!)
  2. *How do you guarantee a transfer doesn't debit A and fail to credit B?* (Rollback/exception safety or command log.)

title: Library Management System
requirements: Manage books, copies (`BookCopy` barcodes), members, borrow/return with due dates, late fine calculation, and catalog search.
relationships:
- `Library` **owns** `BookCopy` inventory (Composition).
  - `BookCopy` **references** `Book` metadata (Aggregation/Association—1 Book, many copies).
  - `LoanRecord` links `Member` and `BookCopy` (Association class).
oopConcepts: Separation of metadata (`Book`) vs physical copy (`BookCopy`), Strategy Pattern (`IFinePolicy`), Rule of 0.
responsibilities:
- `Book`: ISBN, title, author.
  - `BookCopy`: barcode, availability status.
  - `Library`: search index, checkout/return rules (max books per member).
umlDiagram:
Library ◆--- BookCopy ---> Book
Library ◇--- Member
LoanRecord ---> Member, BookCopy
cppApproach: Keep `Book` immutable metadata shared via `std::shared_ptr<const Book>`, while `BookCopy` tracks mutable `status_`. Inject `IFinePolicy` (`FlatPerDayFine`) for OCP.
followUps:
1. *Why separate `Book` from `BookCopy`?* (If a library owns 5 copies of "CLRS", duplicating title/author 5 times wastes space and creates update anomalies.)
  2. *How do you support reserving an already-borrowed book?* (Add a `ReservationQueue` per `Book`.)

title: ATM Machine System
requirements: Card insertion, PIN verification, balance inquiry, cash withdrawal (dispense notes greedily/DP), receipt printing, and machine states (`Idle`, `HasCard`, `Authenticated`, `OutOfCash`).
oopConcepts: **State Pattern** (polymorphism replacing giant `if/switch(state)`), DIP (`IBankBackend`), Encapsulation (PIN never exposed).
responsibilities:
- `IATMState`: handles `insertCard()`, `enterPin()`, `withdraw()` differently per state.
  - `CashDispenser`: tracks denominations (`2000`, `500`, `100`) and validates dispensability.
followUps:
1. *What if the dispenser has `500` notes only and the user asks for `300`?* (Check dispensability *before* debiting bank account!)
  2. *Why use the State Pattern here?* (Prevents withdrawing before PIN entry without scattered `if (state == AUTH)` checks.)

title: Parking Lot System
requirements: Multi-floor parking lot, spot sizes (`Compact`, `Large`, `EV`), vehicle types (`Bike`, `Car`, `Truck`), entry ticket, exit fee calculation (hourly/flat), and nearest-spot allocation.
oopConcepts: Inheritance (`Vehicle`), Composition (floors/spots), Strategy Pattern (`IPricingStrategy`), Singleton/Service root.
responsibilities:
- `ParkingSpot`: tracks `spotType_`, `occupied_`, `canFit(const Vehicle&)`.
  - `ParkingFloor`: finds/frees spots on that floor.
  - `Ticket`: entry timestamp, assigned spot ID.
umlDiagram:
ParkingLot ◆--- ParkingFloor ◆--- ParkingSpot
ParkingLot ---> IPricingStrategy
Ticket ---> ParkingSpot, Vehicle
cppApproach: Use `enum class SpotSize { Small, Medium, Large }` and `Vehicle::requiredSpotSize() const` so `ParkingSpot::canFit()` needs zero `dynamic_cast`!
followUps:
1. *How do you handle concurrent vehicles entering multiple gates?* (Per-floor or spot-bucket mutex + min-heap of free spots.)
  2. *How do you add EV charging fees cleanly?* (Decorator or `EvSpot` pricing strategy.)

title: Online Shopping & Cart System
requirements: Browse `Product`s, manage `ShoppingCart` (`addItem`, `removeItem`, `updateQty`), apply coupons (`IDiscountPolicy`), place `Order`, and process payment.
relationships:
- `ShoppingCart` ◆--- `CartItem` ---> `Product` (Composition of line items, Association to Product).
  - `Order` snapshots `CartItem`s (so later product price changes don't alter past orders!).
oopConcepts: Immutability of historical `Order` snapshots, OCP/Strategy (`IDiscountPolicy`), DIP (`IPaymentGateway`).
responsibilities:
- `ShoppingCart`: mutates quantities, computes subtotal.
  - `Order`: immutable receipt + lifecycle (`Pending`, `Paid`, `Shipped`).
umlDiagram:
ShoppingCart ◆--- CartItem ---> Product
Order ◆--- OrderLineItem
ShoppingCart ---> IDiscountPolicy
cppApproach: `CartItem` stores `std::shared_ptr<const Product>` and `int qty`. When placing an `Order`, copy `unitPrice` and `productName` by value into `OrderLineItem`.
followUps:
1. *Why shouldn't `Order` just point to `Product::currentPrice`?* (If `Product` goes on sale next week, historical invoices would change!)
  2. *How do you handle stock reservation so two users don't buy the last item?* (Atomic inventory decrement/reservation at checkout.)

title: Employee Management & Payroll System
requirements: Different employee types (`Salaried`, `Hourly`, `Commission`), department grouping, tax deductions, and monthly payslip generation.
oopConcepts: Polymorphism (`grossPay()`), Aggregation (`weak_ptr`/`Employee*`), SRP (pay calculation separated from tax & printing).
responsibilities:
- `Employee`: ID, name, `virtual double grossPay() const = 0`.
  - `PayrollEngine`: computes gross -> applies `ITaxCalculator` -> builds `Payslip`.
umlDiagram:
Department ◇--- Employee (abstract)
                   ^
          +--------+--------+
   SalariedEmp         HourlyEmp
PayrollEngine ---> ITaxCalculator
cppApproach: Store `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Employee>>` in HR repository, and `std::vector<Employee*>` (or IDs) inside `Department`.
followUps:
1. *What if a `SalariedEmployee` gets promoted to `Manager`?* (Avoid rigid role inheritance if roles change dynamically—prefer `Employee` **has-a** `IPayStrategy`!)

title: Multi-Provider Payment System
requirements: Support Credit Card, UPI, NetBanking, Wallets; support payments, optional refunds, retries, and webhook logging without changing checkout code.
relationships:
- `StripeProcessor` implements `IPaymentProcessor` and `IRefundable`.
  - `CashOnDelivery` implements `IPaymentProcessor` only (no forced dummy `refund()`!).
  - `PaymentService` **has/uses** `IPaymentProcessor`.
oopConcepts: Interface Segregation Principle (ISP), DIP, OCP, Factory pattern for creating processors.
responsibilities:
- `IPaymentProcessor`: `PaymentResult charge(const PaymentRequest&)`.
  - `PaymentService`: idempotency check, logging, calling processor.
umlDiagram:
PaymentService ---> IPaymentProcessor <--- UpiProcessor
                         ^
                    StripeProcessor ---> IRefundable
followUps:
1. *How do you prevent double-charging if a network call is retried?* (Idempotency key per `PaymentRequest`.)

title: Hospital Management System
requirements: Patients, Doctors (by specialization), Appointments, Medical Records, Prescriptions, and Ward/Bed allocation.
relationships:
- `Patient`, `Doctor` **is-a** `Person`.
  - `Patient` ◆--- `MedicalRecord` (Composition—confidential history owned by patient).
  - `Appointment` links `Doctor`, `Patient`, `TimeSlot` (Association class).
oopConcepts: Inheritance (`Person`), Encapsulation (strict access to `MedicalRecord`), Association class (`Appointment`).
responsibilities:
- `Doctor`: specialization, availability schedule.
  - `Hospital`: books non-overlapping `Appointment`s, assigns rooms.
cppApproach: Store `std::vector<MedicalRecord>` inside `Patient` with `const` accessors for authorized doctors only.
followUps:
1. *How do you prevent double-booking a doctor at 10:00 AM?* (Store sorted intervals or slot map per `Doctor` guarded by a mutex.)

title: Student & Course Management System
requirements: Students enroll/drop courses, courses have max capacity and prerequisites, instructors assign grades, and GPA is computed.
relationships:
- `Enrollment` is the Association class between `Student` and `Course` storing `grade_` and `status_`.
  - `Registrar` coordinates prerequisite & capacity checks.
oopConcepts: Association class (Many-to-Many), Encapsulation, Strategy (`IGradingPolicy` for 4.0 vs 10.0 scale).
responsibilities:
- `Course`: capacity, prerequisites list, enrolled count.
  - `Enrollment`: links student ID + course ID + letter grade.
umlDiagram:
Student <--- Enrollment ---> Course <--- Instructor
Student ---> IGradingPolicy
cppApproach: Keep `Registrar` owning `std::unordered_map<int, Student>`, `std::unordered_map<std::string, Course>`, and `std::vector<Enrollment>` to avoid messy bidirectional pointers.
followUps:
1. *Why use an `Enrollment` object instead of putting grades directly inside `Student`?* (A grade belongs to the *pair* `(Student, Course)` in a specific semester, not to either alone.)

title: Vehicle Rental System
requirements: Search available vehicles (`Car`, `Bike`, `Van`) by branch and date range, book reservation, compute rental cost (daily + mileage/insurance), and handle return/damage inspection.
relationships:
- `Branch` ◇--- `Vehicle` (vehicles can be returned at another branch—Aggregation!).
  - `Reservation` links `Customer`, `Vehicle`, `DateRange`.
oopConcepts: Polymorphism (`Vehicle`), Aggregation (`Branch` <-> `Vehicle`), Strategy (`IRateCalculator`).
responsibilities:
- `Vehicle`: licensePlate, baseDailyRate, status (`Available`, `Rented`, `Maintenance`).
  - `Reservation`: calculates total invoice on return.
umlDiagram:
RentalSystem ◆--- Branch ◇--- Vehicle <--- {Car, Bike, Van}
Reservation ---> Customer, Vehicle, IRateCalculator
cppApproach: Track bookings in `Reservation` intervals `[start, end)` so `isAvailable(vehicleId, start, end)` checks interval overlap cleanly.
followUps:
1. *How do you support one-way rentals (pick up in Delhi, drop in Jaipur)?* (Move vehicle reference from source `Branch` to destination `Branch` on return + add relocation fee in `IRateCalculator`.)

title: Food Ordering & Delivery System
requirements: Browse `Restaurant` menus, build `FoodOrder` with items & add-ons, assign `DeliveryPartner`, track order status (`Placed`, `Preparing`, `OutForDelivery`, `Delivered`), and notify user.
oopConcepts: Composition, Observer (`INotifier` for status updates), Strategy (`IDeliveryMatcher` nearest driver).
responsibilities:
- `FoodOrder`: enforces valid state transitions (`Placed -> Preparing -> OutForDelivery -> Delivered`).
  - `DeliveryPartner`: current GPS location, availability flag.
umlDiagram:
Restaurant ◆--- MenuItem
FoodOrder ◆--- OrderItem
FoodOrder ---> User, DeliveryPartner, INotifier
cppApproach: State machine inside `FoodOrder::advanceStatus(...)` prevents illegal jumps (e.g., `Delivered -> Preparing`).
followUps:
1. *How do you handle restaurant rejection or item out-of-stock after order placement?* (Add `Cancelled` state + trigger `IRefundable` event.)

title: Multi-Channel Notification System
requirements: Send alerts (`Email`, `SMS`, `Push`, `Slack`) based on user preferences, support retry on failure, and format messages cleanly.
oopConcepts: Open/Closed Principle, Dependency Inversion, Polymorphism, Composition.
responsibilities:
- `INotificationChannel`: `bool send(const UserContact&, const NotificationMessage&)`.
  - `NotificationDispatcher`: routes message to user's enabled channels.
umlDiagram:
NotificationDispatcher ---> INotificationChannel <--- {Email, Sms, Push}
NotificationDispatcher ---> IRetryPolicy
cppApproach: Register channels in `std::unordered_map<ChannelType, std::unique_ptr<INotificationChannel>>`.
followUps:
1. *What if a single notification needs to go to both Email and SMS simultaneously?* (Pass `std::vector<ChannelType>` or fan out via `CompositeChannel`!)

title: Movie Ticket Booking System (BookMyShow Style)
requirements: Cities, `Theater`s, `Screen`s, `Show`s (movie + time), seat map (`Regular`, `VIP`), temporary seat locking during payment, and booking confirmation.
oopConcepts: Separation of static `Seat` layout vs per-show `ShowSeat` state, Encapsulation (mutex-protected seat locking), Strategy (dynamic pricing).
responsibilities:
- `ShowSeat`: `Available`, `Locked(expiryTime, userId)`, `Booked`.
  - `BookingService`: locks requested seats atomically -> triggers payment -> confirms or releases lock.
umlDiagram:
Theater ◆--- Screen ◆--- Seat
Show ---> Movie, Screen
Show ◆--- ShowSeat ---> Seat
Booking ---> Show, IPaymentGateway
cppApproach: Guard `Show::lockSeats(seatIds, userId)` with a per-`Show` `std::mutex` and validate all seats are free before locking any (all-or-nothing!).
followUps:
1. *How do you prevent deadlock if two users lock seats `[A1, A2]` and `[A2, A1]` concurrently?* (Sort `seatIds` before locking or use one mutex per `Show`!)

title: Hotel Booking System
requirements: Search available rooms (`Single`, `Suite`, `Deluxe`) for `[checkIn, checkOut)` dates, reserve room, add room-service/amenities, and compute final bill at checkout.
oopConcepts: Composition, Decorator/Composite for billing add-ons, Encapsulation.
responsibilities: - `Reservation`: checks date overlap `(start1 < end2 && start2 < end1)` and generates itemized bill.
umlDiagram:
Hotel ◆--- Room
Reservation ---> Guest, Room
Reservation ◆--- BillItem
cppApproach: Store `Room` pricing via `IRoomRate` strategy so seasonal surge pricing (weekend/holiday) plugs in without touching `Room`.
followUps:
1. *What if a guest upgrades from `Single` to `Suite` mid-stay?* (Split billing periods into `RoomSegment`s inside `Reservation`.)

title: Inventory & Warehouse Management System
requirements: Track `Product` stock across multiple `Warehouse`s/bins, handle incoming shipments, outgoing order picks, low-stock alerts (`IStockObserver`), and batch/expiry tracking.
oopConcepts: Observer Pattern (low-stock alerts), Strategy Pattern (`FIFO` vs `FEFO` expiry picking), SRP.
responsibilities:
- `StockItem`: `quantity_`, `expiryDate_`, `reserve(qty)`.
  - `InventoryManager`: atomic stock transfer between warehouses.
umlDiagram:
Warehouse ◆--- StockItem ---> Product
InventoryManager ---> IStockObserver, IPickStrategy
cppApproach: Keep `quantity_` invariant `>= 0` inside `StockItem::deduct(int n)` under `std::mutex`.
followUps:
1. *How do you handle perishable items (milk) vs electronics?* (`IPickStrategy`: `FEFO` First-Expired-First-Out vs `FIFO`.)

title: Ride-Sharing System (Uber/Ola Style)
requirements: `Rider` requests ride (pickup, drop, `RideType`), system matches nearby `Driver`, tracks ride states (`Requested`, `Accepted`, `Ongoing`, `Completed`), calculates fare, and processes payment.
oopConcepts: Inheritance (`User`), Strategy (`IDriverMatcher`, `IFareCalculator`), State transitions (`Ride`).
responsibilities: - `Ride`: stores fare, distance, timestamps, atomic `accept(Driver*)` so two drivers can't accept one ride!
cppApproach: Use `IFareCalculator` (`Base + PerKm * dist + Surge`) and `std::mutex` on `Ride::accept()` to resolve driver races.
followUps:
1. *How do you implement surge pricing cleanly?* (Decorator/Strategy wrapping `IFareCalculator` based on demand/supply ratio.)

title: Elevator Control System
requirements: Multi-elevator building, internal floor buttons, external Up/Down hall buttons, elevator states (`MovingUp`, `MovingDown`, `Idle`, `Maintenance`), and scheduling algorithm (`IScheduler`).
oopConcepts: Composition, Strategy Pattern (`IScheduler`), State machine (`Direction`), Encapsulation.
responsibilities:
- `ElevatorCar`: `currentFloor_`, `Direction`, sorted stop queues (`upStops_`, `downStops_`).
  - `IScheduler`: picks optimal `ElevatorCar` for a hall request.
umlDiagram:
ElevatorController ◆--- ElevatorCar ◆--- Door
ElevatorController ---> IScheduler
cppApproach: Separate `upStops_` (min-heap) and `downStops_` (max-heap) inside `ElevatorCar` for classic LOOK/SCAN behavior.
followUps:
1. *How do you handle overweight sensors or fire emergency mode?* (Override priority state in `ElevatorCar`—doors stay open / return to ground floor.)

title: Social Media Feed & Follow System
requirements: Users create `Post`s, follow/unfollow other users, like/comment on posts, and fetch top-K recent feed posts (`IFeedGenerator`).
oopConcepts: SRP (`FollowGraph` separated from `User`), Strategy (`IFeedGenerator`), Rule of 0.
responsibilities:
- `FollowGraph`: `follow(u1, u2)`, `unfollow(u1, u2)`, `getFollowees(u1)`.
  - `ChronologicalFeed`: k-way merge of followees' recent posts using `std::priority_queue`.
umlDiagram:
SocialNetwork ◆--- User, FollowGraph
Post ◆--- Comment
SocialNetwork ---> IFeedGenerator
cppApproach: Store IDs (`UserId`, `PostId`) in `unordered_map` repositories rather than raw `User*` to eliminate dangling-pointer bugs on account deletion.
followUps:
1. *How does push (fan-out on write) vs pull (fan-out on read) affect celebrity users?* (Hybrid `IFeedGenerator`!)

title: Vending Machine System
requirements: Display products & prices, accept coins/notes, select item, dispense item + change, refund on cancel, and handle out-of-stock / insufficient funds cleanly.
oopConcepts: **State Pattern** (crucial here!), Encapsulation, Composition.
responsibilities:
- `IVendingState`: defines `insertMoney()`, `selectItem()`, `dispense()`, `cancel()`.
  - `CoinBox`: verifies exact change is possible before vending.
cppApproach: Keep concrete state instances (or `std::unique_ptr<IVendingState>`) inside `VendingMachine` and transition cleanly via `setState(...)`.
followUps:
1. *What if the machine can't make change for a 100 note when item costs 65?* (Check greedy/DP coin availability *before* dispensing; if unavailable, reject or prompt exact change.)

title: Extensible Logger & File Rotation System
requirements: Support log levels (`DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARN`, `ERROR`), multiple output sinks (`ConsoleSink`, `FileSink`, `NetworkSink`), custom formatters (`IFormatter`), thread safety, and size-based log file rotation.
oopConcepts: SRP (formatting vs routing vs writing), OCP/DIP (`ILogSink`), RAII (`std::ofstream` / `std::mutex`), Rule of 5 / Meyers' Singleton or DI.
responsibilities:
- `ILogSink`: `write(const std::string& formattedLine)`.
  - `RotatingFileSink`: checks `bytesWritten_ >= maxBytes_`, closes current file, renames/opens next segment.
umlDiagram:
Logger ◆--- ILogSink <--- {ConsoleSink, RotatingFileSink}
Logger ---> IFormatter
cppApproach: Guard `Logger::log()` with `std::mutex`, filter by `minLevel_` *before* formatting string (saves CPU when `DEBUG` is off!).
followUps: 1. *How do you prevent slow disk I/O in `FileSink` from blocking application threads?* (Use a producer-consumer queue + background worker thread—Async Logger!)
